# Package `thaumcraft.api.aura`

[All packages](README.md)

Types: [`AuraHelper`](#aurahelper)

## AuraHelper

```java
public final class AuraHelper
```

The aura helper of the add-on surface, projected onto the native TC4 aura node.

Forced 1.21.1 change: TC4 has no per-chunk aura and no flux; the native aura is the aura node's own stored essence. The vis accessors therefore read and write the node at the given position, the drain reaches the vis network at the given position, and the flux accessors of the TC6 shape do not exist in this port.


The node at the position, or null when there is none.

<a id="aurahelper-drainvis"></a>
```java
public static int drainVis(Level level, BlockPos pos, int amount, boolean simulate)
```

Removes essence from the vis network at the position.

The retained 1.12 reference drained the VIS NETWORK and not the essence of the node at the position: `src/main/java/thaumcraft/common/world/aura/AuraHandler.java:27-33` delegates to `VisNetHandler.drainVis(world, x, y, z, requested, simulate)`, and that method walks the primal aspects of every root source that is in range of the position (`src/main/java/thaumcraft/api/visnet/VisNetHandler.java:92-139`). The native projection keeps that selection: the drain reaches the whole network at the position, not one node.

**Returns:** the amount that was (or would be) removed

**Parameters:**
- `amount` — the amount to remove
- `simulate` — true to report what would be removed without changing the network

<a id="aurahelper-addvis"></a>
```java
public static int addVis(Level level, BlockPos pos, AspectList aspects)
```

Adds essence to the node at the position; the node's own acceptance rules apply.
